And so can you.

Paper starts plain — then becomes a bird, a frog, a friend.
You can become anything too. Just keep folding, keep trying, keep dreaming.
The most beautiful shape is the one you're still becoming.

Inspired by Louis Kahn’s “even a brick wants to be something,” as echoed in Indecent Proposal (1993).Watch the scene on YouTube ↗
